decisions.content: Added interactive Terminal UI (tui.py), ASCII/Unicode dependency graph visualizer, dependency tree, and system doctor.
Implemented OpenCode-style interactive arrow-key TUI, eliminated Vietnamese strings from developer UI, added standalone interactive web graph (rt web), and God Nodes / chokepoint centrality analysis.

Replaced external CDN with self-contained HTML5 Canvas Force-Directed engine in graph.html, eliminated terminal screen flickering via ANSI in-place buffer, removed all symbol and file truncations in architecture_map and TUI, and added line-bound reading rules for AI.

decisions.topic: Web Graph Layout Optimization & Independent Sync Action
decisions.content: Enhanced web visualizer with hard circle collision avoidance, adjustable spacing slider, hide-isolated toggle, and type/connection filters. Split Update (incremental) and Rebuild (clean cache) into distinct menu items, and updated README documentation.
Enhanced launch_browser to directly locate and spawn Google Chrome executable on Windows, macOS, and Linux before falling back to default shell association.
Restored print_header method in TerminalUI to fix AttributeError on option 1. Updated launch_browser with Windows shell start chrome and explicit URL printout in _handle_web.

conventions: All internal functions must have type hints
